m307_cycle_replay.interpretation: Most of each total ratio comes from the tau0 exact PWP path; selective lossy elision adds only 6.7506% WIDE144 or 4.8245% SHARED96 in this isolated four-Conv replay.

findings.title: The adaptive drop-one choice is not fully specified by the preregistered text
findings.evidence: The contract was SHA-bound before all five runs and says to rank delta AEE per M280 saved cycle, but it neither states to drop the maximum ratio nor defines a per-operator cycle denominator. M280 supplies per-operator elided correction-work proxies, not per-operator executable cycles. The observed proxy ranking does make op1 worst and only enable[0,2,3] was run.
findings.impact: The five-screen execution is consistent with the intended rule, but the uniqueness of enable[0,2,3] is not fully derivable from the frozen contract alone.
findings.required_fix: Before valid825, freeze a correction stating the exact denominator, ranking direction, tie-break, and unique selected set [0,2,3]; do not run another S10 combination.

findings.title: The selected candidate is chosen and evaluated on one S10 single-sequence cohort
findings.evidence: All attribution and combination decisions use the same ordered ten frames from zurich_city_09_a. Enable023 passes by 0.005638 AEE, but valid825 has not run.
findings.impact: The pass is a screening result subject to selection bias and cannot establish network accuracy.
findings.required_fix: Run exactly the frozen enable[0,2,3] candidate on paired running-BN valid825 without further candidate search.

findings.title: Runtime snapped totals are not M280 lossy-approximation counts
findings.evidence: The four single-layer runtime snapped totals are [1859278,1244421,2185824,1322117], while M280 distance>0 approximated counts are [984456,556939,1179925,620695]. Runtime totals include distance-zero exact hits; downstream distributions also change in multi-layer modified forwards.
findings.impact: Calling runtime snapped rows lossy or subtracting M280 counts from multi-layer runtime totals would misstate approximation prevalence.
findings.required_fix: Add separate runtime exact-hit and positive-distance counters in the valid825 receipt.

findings.title: M307 total ratios are dominated by the tau0 exact path
findings.evidence: Selected tau[1,0,1,1] reports WIDE144 1.644554x and SHARED96 1.292379x versus bit-sparse, but only 1.067506x and 1.048245x incrementally versus tau0 exact. The replay is isolated to four Conv layers and has no executable SRAM/control RTL.
findings.impact: Attributing the total ratio to selective lossy elision, hardware, or the system would overstate the contribution.
findings.required_fix: Always publish total and incremental columns together and keep both trace-opportunity-only until executable hardware and whole-network composition exist.
